title: RAG Makes Guardrails Brittle? Investigating Robustness of Guardrails under RAG-style Contexts
abstract: arXiv:2510.05310v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: With the increasing adoption of large language models (LLMs), ensuring the safety of LLM systems has become a pressing concern. External LLM-based guardrail models have emerged as a popular solution to screen unsafe inputs and outputs, but they are themselves fine-tuned or prompt-engineered LLMs vulnerable to data distribution shifts. In this paper, taking Retrieval Augmentation Generation (RAG) as a case study, we investigate how robust LLM-based guardrails are against additional information embedded in the context. Through a systematic evaluation of 3 Llama Guards and 2 GPT-oss models, we find that inserting benign retrieved documents flips the judgments of input and output guardrails in around 11% and 8% of cases respectively, with the majority of these flips (72% and 64%) reversing previously correct decisions. We further analyze the effect of each component in the augmented context: retrieved documents, user query, and LLM

translated_title: RAG让防护栏变得脆弱？研究RAG式上下文下安全防护栏的鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）的日益普及，确保LLM系统的安全性已成为一个紧迫的问题。基于LLM的外部防护栏模型已成为筛选不安全输入和输出的流行解决方案，但它们本身是经过微调或提示工程设计的LLM，容易受到数据分布偏移的影响。本文以检索增强生成（RAG）为案例研究，考察基于LLM的防护栏对嵌入上下文中额外信息的鲁棒性。通过对3个Llama Guard模型和2个GPT-oss模型的系统性评估，我们发现仅仅插入良性的检索文档，就会使输入和输出防护栏的判断分别在大约11%和8%的情况下发生翻转，其中大多数翻转（72%和64%）是将原本正确的判断反转为错误判断。我们进一步分析了增强上下文中各组件（检索文档、用户查询和LLM）的影响。
tldr: 本研究通过系统评估发现，RAG场景中仅插入良性的检索文档就能使基于LLM的安全防护栏在约10%的情况下翻转判断，且多数翻转会将原本正确的安全决策反转为错误决策，揭示了现有防护栏在RAG式上下文下的脆弱性。
